wrong: 收益相同所以控制必须相同
忽略损害只比较速度

wrong: 复核员签名不够漂亮

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。

prompt.zh: 本演练规定：先确认负责人及运行手册，再联合演练告警、接手与回退，验证通过才接收版本/资料持续维护。按交接依赖重排，文件复制不能单独完成交接。
prompt.en: Exercise dependencies: confirm owners and runbooks, jointly drill alerts, takeover and rollback, then accept ongoing version/source maintenance after validation. Reorder the handover; copying files alone is insufficient.

reason.zh: 演练需要已明确的接手人和操作依据；验证后仍要持续版本与资料维护。仅交模型文件会留下运行责任空白。 回看“值守、告警、回退与变更”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Drills need named owners and operating instructions; ongoing version/source maintenance remains after validation. A model file alone leaves operating accountability unassigned. Revisit Operations, alerts, rollback and change and the stated exercise conditions.

text.zh: 接收版本变更与资料持续维护责任
text.en: Accept ongoing version-change and source-maintenance ownership

reason.en: Scale changes workload and conditions, so original assumptions need revalidation. Revisit Performance, continuity, training and support.

text.en: Assume pilot quality and cost stay unchanged at any scale

text.en: Revalidate capacity, latency, permissions, training, support and continuity and adjust pace by evidence

questions.q: 扩展到新地区时，为什么不能直接沿用原成本与质量结论？
questions.a: 新地区的负载、资料权限与支持条件可能不同，原质量和成本假设需要重新验证
wrong: 假设原试点质量与成本在所有规模都不变

en.q: Why cannot original quality and cost conclusions simply be reused in a new region?
en.a: Workload, data permissions and support conditions may differ in the new region, so prior quality and cost assumptions require revalidation
wrong: Assume pilot quality and cost stay unchanged at any scale
